restrictionsOnAtliq.description: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.
restrictionsOnAtliq.quote: 5.3 Non-Solicitation of Datavane Accounts. During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.

data.valueText: Joint Deal Revenue Share: 20% to Partner, 80% to Datavane. Referral Fee: 8% of first-year net subscription fees for Prospects referred by Partner that purchase a Platform subscription without Partner Services.
